rule.description: Center for Internet Security Debian Linux 13 Benchmark: Ensure nftables default deny firewall policy.: Status changed from failed to passed

sca.policy: Center for Internet Security Debian Linux 13 Benchmark

check.title: Ensure nftables default deny firewall policy.
check.description: Base chain policy is the default verdict that will be applied to packets reaching the end of the chain.
check.rationale: There are two policies: accept (Default) and drop. If the policy is set to accept, the firewall will accept any packet that is not configured to be denied and the packet will continue transversing the network stack. It is easier to allow list acceptable usage than to deny list unacceptable usage. Note: - Allow port 22(ssh) needs to be updated to only allow systems requiring ssh connectivity to connect, as per site policy. - Changing firewall settings while connected over network can result in being locked out of the system.
check.remediation: Run the following command for the base chains with the input, forward, and output hooks to implement a default DROP policy: # nft chain <table family> <table name> <chain name> { policy drop \; } Example: # nft chain inet filter input { policy drop \; } # nft chain inet filter forward { policy drop \; } # nft chain inet filter output { policy drop \; }.
